title: Standardization of Body Composition Status in Patients with Advanced Urothelial Tumors: The Role of a CT-Based AI-Powered Software for the Assessment of Sarcopenia and Patient Outcome Correlation.
summary: Quantib CT software automatically segmented L3 muscle in 97 retrospectively studied advanced urothelial-tumor patients; body-composition changes associated with chemotherapy response/survival. Single-center observational correlation, not a causal treatment effect.
